acceptanceCriteria: policy update --dry-run returns handoffFences and writes nothing (journal, receipts and policy bytes unchanged).
A test proves a dry run leaves the store byte-identical.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

From the V1-0888 lane (GitHub #643), 2026-10-06: policy update now returns handoffFences after the write commits. The issue's minimum ask was a warning before commit; a --dry-run (or confirm) mode would let an operator see which live attempts an update fences and abort.
title: corvint-tasks policy update: preview handoff fences before committing (--dry-run)
